episodes.title: What is Botany?
episodes.description: In this episode of Crash Course Botany, we’ll find out what botanists study and how knowledge of plants can help you navigate everyday life.

episodes.title: What Are Plants Made Of?
episodes.description: Explore plant organs, including roots, stems, and leaves, and how they build a plant.

episodes.title: Plant Cells & Hormones
episodes.description: Compare plant and animal cells and explore the distinctive features of plant cells.

episodes.title: What Do These Creepy Plant Mouths Do? (Plant Tissues)
episodes.description: Look inside plants under a microscope to examine tissues and the structures that make up plant anatomy.

episodes.title: Photosynthesis and Cellular Respiration
episodes.description: Explore photosynthesis and cellular respiration, their importance for life, and their potential contributions to a greener future.

episodes.title: How Did Plants Evolve?
episodes.description: Trace the origins of plants, the forces shaping their evolution, and evidence of Earth before plants appeared.

episodes.title: How Do We Categorize Plants?
episodes.description: In this episode of Crash Course Botany, we’ll explore how taxonomy and systematics help us understand what plants are and where they come from.

episodes.title: Why These Plants Don’t Need Seeds (Moss & Ferns)
episodes.description: Explore bryophytes and seedless vascular plants, including mosses and ferns, and their place in plant evolution.

episodes.title: Why Flowers Exist (Gymnosperms & Angiosperms)
episodes.description: You couldn’t go a day without interacting with gymnosperms and angiosperms, the two most prominent groups of plants on the planet.

episodes.title: What Do Pea Plants Have To Do With Your Eye Color? (Mendelian Genetics)
episodes.description: Discover how Mendel’s pea experiments established principles of inheritance and helped lay the foundations of genetics.

episodes.title: GMOs are Nothing New (Plant Breeding & Gene Editing)
episodes.description: Trace plant genetic manipulation from selective breeding to gene editing, including questions about genetically modified crops.

episodes.title: The Secret Social Lives of Plants (Population & Community Ecology)
episodes.description: Explore interactions among plants, populations, and communities and how ecology can guide conservation.

episodes.title: How We ALL Get Our Energy (Plants & Ecosystems)
episodes.description: Examine how plants form the foundations of ecosystems and support interactions between organisms and their environments.

episodes.title: Can Planting Trees Fix Climate Change? (Plants & Biomes)
episodes.description: Explore plants’ ecological roles in Earth’s biomes and how climate change affects deserts, savannas, tropical forests, and other environments.

episodes.title: The Future of Botany
episodes.description: Explore unresolved plant mysteries, connections between Western science and traditional knowledge, and possibilities for gardening on the Moon.
